# Atlas - internal deployment tool
https://atlas.example/

Atlas is the internal deployment tool for the Atlas rollout.
It is owned and maintained by the ops team.
Current stable release: 1.2.0.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/docs
- https://atlas.example/pricing
- https://atlas.example/blog/2026-03-release-1-2
- https://status.example/atlas

# Atlas documentation
https://atlas.example/docs

Guides for installing, configuring and operating Atlas.
Start with the installation guide, then the configuration guide.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/docs/install
- https://atlas.example/docs/config
- https://atlas.example/docs/limits
- https://atlas.example/docs/changelog

# Atlas rate limits and quotas
https://atlas.example/docs/limits

API requests: 600 per minute per API key.
Concurrent deployments: 5 per project.
Webhook delivery retries: 8 attempts with exponential backoff (raised from 5 in release 1.2.0).
Last reviewed 2026-04-02.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/docs/changelog

# Atlas changelog
https://atlas.example/docs/changelog

Release history for Atlas.
1.2.0 (2026-03-14): Added export to CSV and Parquet. Webhook retry limit raised from 5 to 8.
1.1.0 (2025-11-20): Fixed login bug affecting SSO users.
1.0.0 (2025-06-01): First stable release.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/blog/2026-03-release-1-2

# Atlas service status
https://status.example/atlas

All systems operational as of 2026-10-01.
Last incident: 2026-09-18, webhook delivery delays, duration 42 minutes.
Uptime over the last 90 days: 99.95%.

Links:
- https://status.example/atlas/incidents/2026-09-18
